defeats.how: After Doctor Octopus pulled off Spider-Man's mask, sudden painful cramps from Peter's ulcer forced him to flee the fight.
defeats.evidence: Peter is suddenly struck by painful cramps and has to flee the fight

defeats.how: Weakened by his ulcer, Spider-Man put on the body harness he took earlier, which gave him the boost to defeat Doctor Octopus.
defeats.evidence: Spider-Man gets the needed boost to defeat Dr. Octopus
